key.name: show-icon
key.description: Display the Claude logo in the panel.

key.name: panel-gauge
key.description: Which usage gauge to draw in the panel: a circular ring, a horizontal bar, or none.

key.name: show-percentage
key.description: Display the usage percentage number in the panel.

key.name: show-tier
key.description: Display the subscription tier label (e.g. MAX) in the panel, after the Claude icon.

key.name: show-tier-icon
key.description: Display the icon of the subscription tier in the panel, after the Claude icon. A tier without its own icon (e.g. Max 5x / 20x) uses the icon of its base tier; a tier with no artwork at all shows no icon.

key.name: show-reset
key.description: Display, in the panel, the time left before each window shown there (see panel-windows) resets. Windows that reset together (the 7-day and per-model 7-day windows) share one countdown, after the last of them.

key.name: show-profile-chip
key.description: Display a short two-letter tag before each profile's gauge in the panel, to tell profiles apart. Only ever shown when more than one profile is configured.

key.name: panel-window
key.description: Deprecated: superseded by panel-windows, which can hold several selectors. Read once, on first run after the upgrade, to seed panel-windows with the previous single choice.

key.name: panel-windows
key.description: Which usage windows the panel shows, one gauge (ring/bar, percentage) per window, tagged "5h"/"7d"/model name when more than one is shown. Accepted selectors: five-hour (the 5-hour window), seven-day (the 7-day all-models window), scoped (every per-model 7-day window, e.g. Fable), max (whichever window has the highest utilization), worst (the worst active limit by severity — surfaces a maxed-out per-model window). Unknown selectors are ignored and a window matched by several selectors is shown once. Empty falls back to the first window.

key.name: panel-divider
key.description: Text placed between the groups of gauges when the panel shows more than one window (see panel-windows), e.g. "·". Windows that reset together (the 7-day and per-model 7-day windows) are one group, with no divider inside it. Exactly "|" draws a thin vertical line; blank or whitespace-only (the default) leaves a plain gap.

key.name: panel-lead-divider
key.description: Text placed between the leading elements (Claude icon, profile tag, subscription tier icon and label) and the gauges, and between profiles. Exactly "|" (the default) draws a thin vertical line; blank or whitespace-only shows no divider at all.

key.name: ui-style
key.description: JSON object of the style values changed from their defaults under "Top-Bar UI" and "Popup UI" in preferences, keyed by the ids in lib/uiStyle.js, e.g. {"panel-tier-icon.color": "#ff0000", "panel.spacing": 8}. A value that is absent keeps its default from stylesheet.css; unknown ids and invalid values are ignored.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which section of the top bar the indicator sits in: left (next to Activities), center (by the clock), or right (the status area).

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Where the indicator sits among the other items in its panel box. 0 is the first slot; larger values move it further along. Values beyond the number of items simply place it last.

key.name: toggle-menu
key.summary: Shortcut to open the usage popup
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens and closes the usage dropdown, the same as clicking the panel indicator. Empty means no shortcut is bound.

key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: How often, in seconds, to poll for updated usage.

key.name: profiles
key.description: JSON array of {id, label, configDir} objects, one per Claude Code profile (a directory such as ~/.claude or ~/.claude-work holding its own .credentials.json).

key.name: profiles-initialized
key.summary: Whether the profile list has been seeded
key.description: Set once auto-detection has populated "profiles" for the first time, so a user who removes every profile afterwards isn't re-seeded.

key.name: profile-tokens
key.description: JSON object mapping a profile id to its in-app sign-in tokens ({accessToken, refreshToken, expiresAt}). Each profile signs in to its own Claude account; the older single access-token/refresh-token keys are migrated into here on first use.

key.name: access-token
key.description: Access token from the in-app sign-in, used only when Claude Code is not signed in.

key.name: refresh-token
key.description: Refresh token from the in-app sign-in, used to renew the access token.

key.name: expires-at
key.description: Millisecond timestamp when the in-app access token expires.
